reader.requirement: At --std 85 the report footing's first print line is placed by Table 5: (a) an absolute first LINE on its integer; (b) a relative first LINE, paged, on the page footing's final LINE-COUNTER plus the integer when a page footing was presented on the current page, otherwise on FOOTING integer-5 plus the integer; (c) LINE n ON NEXT PAGE on line n of a page holding no other group; (d) unpaged, on LINE-COUNTER plus the integer; (e) with no LINE clause, not presented; and the combinations the table calls illegal (absolute LINE without PAGE) and LINE ON NEXT PAGE with no integer are refused.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.TerminateDiscardsSavedNextGroup: at 85 a saved absolute NEXT GROUP integer is kept for the control footings TERMINATE produces; it does not enter the report footing's placement (b uses the page footing's LINE-COUNTER or FOOTING, d is unpaged where no save arises)
DialectBehavior.ControlFootingPageGroupsSeePriorControlValues: control values the last page footing sees (content, not position)
ReportLineNextPage2002: LINE NEXT PAGE with no integer refused at 85 (COBOL0900)

reader.edition-search: grep DialectBehaviors.IsActive|Edition in ReportWriter.cs: four switches (lines 734, 964, 1080, 1490), none in FirstLineTarget, PresentHeadingFooting or PresentLine; the placement arms are one code path for every edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for placement: the 2023 GR5b5/GR5a/GR5c arms FirstLineTarget implements give the same lines; 85 refuses the 2002 bare LINE NEXT PAGE form
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf35_06 covers a, b (both arms), c, d, e with single-line footings; not exercised: multi-line footings (A R, NP R), the illegal combinations, the bare NEXT PAGE form

reader.notes: FirstLineTarget's ReportFooting arm is _pfOnThisPage ? LineCounter + relative : _footing + relative, absolute lines return their integer and an unpaged report LineCounter + relative; PresentHeadingFooting takes the bare page feed for a first line with NEXT PAGE (no page footing or heading on that page). A first probe putting a PF on FOOTING (17) was refused by COBOL2199, correctly: §1985:XIII.3.10.9 GR1 puts the PF's upper limit at integer-5 + 1.

refuter.evidence: Attacked the 1985 rule that the page footing's NEXT GROUP moves the report footing (§1985:XIII.3.16.4 GR4 with Table 4 rules 5a/5b): r4pfng.cob (runs/r4pfng-001) PF LINE 15 NEXT GROUP 17 then RF LINE PLUS 1 -> line 18; PF NEXT GROUP PLUS 2 then RF PLUS 1, PLUS 1 -> 18, 19. r4rw.cob (runs/r4rw-001): RF relative with no PF and FOOTING omitted (LAST DETAIL 12 gives integer-5, §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR2e) -> 12+3 = 15; a NONPRINTABLE PF (no LINE) does not count as presented, RF PLUS 2 -> FOOTING 14 + 2 = 16; multi-page report, RF after the page-2 PF -> 16, 18; RF LINE 3 ON NEXT PAGE with a PH defined -> page 2 holds only RF lines 3 and 5 (no PH, no PF). r4save.cob (runs/r4save-001, same at --std 2023 r4save-002): a saved CF FINAL absolute NEXT GROUP does not move the RF (NP RF page 2 lines 3,4; relative RF FOOTING+2 = 16). r4ref.cob: RF 'LINE 16 18' (2002 multiple-integer form) refused COBOL0900. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.10.10 GR3 the text is in GR3; OK §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR2 (the text is in GR2).
